text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Wow, Satono Crown, Vivlos, 
both of you were absolutely adorable!

Daring Tact was practicing for an upcoming 
concert 
with her classmates. She wanted feedback 
from an audience, 
so I was observing the session.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
We're up next... 
Tact, are you good to go?

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
You seemed pretty deep in thought 
while watching Crown and Vivlos perform.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes... When it comes to ad-libbing 
during the interlude, 
I realized I'm not nearly as good at it as 
the two of them.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I felt that instead of just waving my 
hands, 
I ought to add much more variety to my 
movement.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
How do you all usually 
come up with your ad-libs?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Ad-libbing during a performance? 
Well, isn't it obvious?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown & Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
It's all about vibes! 
Vibes, totally~☆

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
If it's a fiery, passionate song, 
you just move fiercely along with the 
raging storm in your heart—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
And if it's a happy song, 
you show how suuuuper fun it is~♪, you 
know?!

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
...True enough. In my case, though, 
it feels more like a character suited to 
the piece descends upon me.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
"Rock 'n' roll means it's my time to 
shine! 
Don't you dare get thrown off—brace 
yourselves!"

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Something like that. What about you, Tact? 
If it were a rock track, how would you 
move?

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
In that case... Tell me, Tact! 
What sort of setting allows you 
to feel most like your true self?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Most like myself... Mountain seclusion, 
definitely!

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Then let's imagine a scene in mountain 
seclusion 
and find an inspiration for your 
ad-libbing!

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
—Deep in the mountains, not a single soul 
is around. 
High above, the leaves gently rustle, 
murmuring their soft melodies.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Alone in the dense wilderness stands Tact. 
Yet all around her, she can sense the 
vibrant breath of countless living things.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Deep, quiet mountains... 
Just me... and the lives nurtured by the 
wild...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
This is... just like theatrical improv 
training...! 
Improv expands the imagination and weaves 
stories through ad-libs.
choice_data_list: So it's perfect for ad-lib practice.
So it's perfect for ad-lib practice, then.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
—And as Tact commences her secluded 
training, 
far removed from human civilization, 
she...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...I, too, shall become a life dwelling 
here. 
I shall survive. And to do so, I will 
become part of the cycle of life—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Giving thanks to the mountain and every 
life breathing within it...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Tact is... Tact made a move!

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, the bushes rustle with a 
restless stirring! An ominous presence! 
Appearing before Tact is—

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
A giant snake! Non-venomous! 
Its tongue flicks in and out as it fixes 
its gaze on Tact!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...You, too, are a fellow soul living upon 
this mountain. 
Let us respect each other's existence...!

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Tact then treks along the mountain trail 
in search of food. 
Before long, she reaches the edge of a 
cliff. 
Yet fierce winds blast mercilessly against 
her!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ah... This is the true harshness of Mother 
Nature. 
A wind of blessing that will make me 
stronger...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Just then—oh no! A bear appears!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
! ...Neither of us should draw closer. 
You understand that as well, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Tact climbs down below the cliff! 
There are fish in the river! Food time, 
catch 'em~☆

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...I shall gratefully receive your life as 
nourishment!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
We've been tossing crazy curveballs at her 
the whole time, 
and yet... why does she still seem 
completely transcendent?!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It's kinda divine, actually... 
Like a goddess of nature~!
choice_data_list:
Still, that felt very true to who you are, 
Tact!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Really? 
I found it so much easier to move when 
thinking about the mountains.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, looks like you've found your spark. 
Do you feel better about ad-libbing now, 
Tact?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes, thanks to you, Win Marilyn! 
I've realized that drawing on things 
familiar to me 
makes visualizing much easier.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
So going forward, I'll picture scenes that 
fit the mood of the song 
and come up with my ad-libs from there.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure that will let me 
perform ad-libs that feel truly like 
myself...!

I'll cheer you on with the heart of an Ezo

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Oh, that makes me so happy to hear!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I know! Next time, Tore-san, 
would you mind giving me some scenarios to 
try?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
You know all about Hidaka's nature, 
so I feel like you could help me discover 
movements even more true to myself.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, that's a promise. 
I'll be counting on you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
An Ezo sika deer... 
That makes me feel a little lonely, to be 
honest.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ezo deer are extremely cautious, 
so they usually just watch you from a 
great distance.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
If possible, I'd be much happier... 
with an animal that doesn't mind coming 
close.

I resolved to do some research later 
on wild animals native to Hidaka that 
aren't quite so timid.

title: At the Whim of the Northern Wilds
